mapper.select: WITH car AS ( SELECT row_number() OVER (ORDER BY car04_date) AS seq , t.* FROM ( SELECT car01_info.* , car04_journal.* , SUM(CASE WHEN car04_close_yn = 'true' THEN car04_after_mileage ELSE COALESCE(car04_mileage,0) END) OVER (ORDER BY car04_date) - COALESCE(car04_mileage,0) as car04_before_mileage_calc FROM car01_info INNER JOIN car04_journal ON car04_info_id = car01_info_id WHERE car01_company_id = #{companyId} AND car01_info_id = #{infoId} AND car01_car_type = '1' AND car04_date >= COALESCE(( SELECT MAX(car04_date) FROM car04_journal WHERE car04_company_id = car01_company_id AND car04_info_id = car01_info_id AND COALESCE(car04_close_yn,'false') = 'true' AND car04_date < TO_DATE(#{stdMonth}||'.01','yyyy.mm.dd') ),'1999-01-01') ) t ) SELECT car04_journal_id AS journal_id , car04_company_id AS company_id , car04_info_id AS info_id , car04_date AS "date" , car04_person_id AS person_id , car04_mileage AS mileage , CASE WHEN COALESCE(car04_close_yn,'false') = 'true' THEN car04_before_mileage ELSE car04_before_mileage_calc2 END AS before_mileage , CASE WHEN COALESCE(car04_close_yn,'false') = 'true' THEN car04_after_mileage ELSE car04_before_mileage_calc2 + COALESCE(car04_mileage,0) END AS after_mileage , car04_commute_mileage AS commute_mileage , car04_biz_mileage AS biz_mileage , car04_un_biz_mileage AS un_biz_mileage , car04_destination AS destination , car04_reason AS reason , car04_note AS note , car04_booking_id AS booking_id , (COALESCE(car04_fix_yn, 'false') = 'true') AS fix_yn , (COALESCE(car04_close_yn, 'false') = 'true') AS close_yn , COALESCE(car04_commute_mileage, 0) + COALESCE(car04_biz_mileage, 0) AS business_mileage , car01_car_no||' - '||car01_car_nm AS info_nm , ( SELECT f_emp_kor_nm(car02_person_id) FROM car02_user WHERE car02_info_id = car01_info_id AND to_char(car02_start_date,'YYYY.MM') <= #{stdMonth} ORDER BY car02_start_date DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS info_person_nm FROM ( SELECT car04_before_mileage_calc + ( SELECT CASE WHEN coalesce(car04_close_yn,'false') = 'false' THEN car01_init_mileage ELSE 0 END FROM car WHERE seq = 1 ) as car04_before_mileage_calc2 , car.* FROM car ) t2 WHERE to_char(car04_date,'YYYY.MM') = #{stdMonth} ORDER BY seq

WITH car AS ( SELECT row_number() OVER (ORDER BY car04_date) AS seq , t.* FROM ( SELECT car01_info.* , car04_journal.* , SUM(CASE WHEN car04_close_yn = 'true' THEN car04_after_mileage ELSE COALESCE(car04_mileage,0) END) OVER (ORDER BY car04_date) - COALESCE(car04_mileage,0) as car04_before_mileage_calc FROM car01_info INNER JOIN car04_journal ON car04_info_id = car01_info_id WHERE car01_company_id = #{companyId} AND car01_info_id = #{infoId} AND car01_car_type = '1' AND car04_date >= COALESCE(( SELECT MAX(car04_date) FROM car04_journal WHERE car04_company_id = car01_company_id AND car04_info_id = car01_info_id AND COALESCE(car04_close_yn,'false') = 'true' AND car04_date < #{date}),'1999-01-01') ) t ) SELECT car04_journal_id AS journal_id , car04_company_id AS company_id , car04_info_id AS info_id , car04_date AS "date" , car04_person_id AS person_id , car04_mileage AS mileage , CASE WHEN COALESCE(car04_close_yn,'false') = 'true' THEN car04_before_mileage ELSE car04_before_mileage_calc2 END AS before_mileage , CASE WHEN COALESCE(car04_close_yn,'false') = 'true' THEN car04_after_mileage ELSE car04_before_mileage_calc2 + COALESCE(car04_mileage,0) END AS after_mileage , car04_commute_mileage AS commute_mileage , car04_biz_mileage AS biz_mileage , car04_un_biz_mileage AS un_biz_mileage , car04_destination AS destination , car04_reason AS reason , car04_note AS note , car04_booking_id AS booking_id , (COALESCE(car04_fix_yn, 'false') = 'true') AS fix_yn , (COALESCE(car04_close_yn, 'false') = 'true') AS close_yn , COALESCE(car04_commute_mileage, 0) + COALESCE(car04_biz_mileage, 0) AS business_mileage , car01_car_no||' - '||car01_car_nm AS info_nm , NULL AS info_person_nm FROM ( SELECT car04_before_mileage_calc + ( SELECT CASE WHEN coalesce(car04_close_yn,'false') = 'false' THEN car01_init_mileage ELSE 0 END FROM car WHERE seq = 1 ) as car04_before_mileage_calc2 , car.* FROM car ) t2 WHERE car04_date <= #{date} ORDER BY seq DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT , car04_before_mileage AS before_mileage, car04_after_mileage AS after_mileage, NULL AS info_nm, NULL AS info_person_nm FROM car04_journal WHERE car04_company_id = #{companyId} AND car04_journal_id = #{journalId}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM car04_journal INNER JOIN car01_info ON car01_info_id = car04_info_id WHERE car04_info_id = #{infoId} AND car04_company_id = #{companyId} AND COALESCE(car04_close_yn, 'false') = 'true' AND TO_DATE(#{stdMonth}, 'YYYY.MM') + INTERVAL '1 months' <= car04_date

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM car04_journal INNER JOIN car01_info ON car01_info_id = car04_info_id WHERE car04_info_id = #{infoId} AND car04_company_id = #{companyId} AND COALESCE(car04_fix_yn, 'false') = 'true' AND TO_DATE(#{stdMonth}, 'YYYY.MM') + INTERVAL '1 months' <= car04_date
SELECT sys12_day FROM sys12_calendar WHERE sys12_working_yn NOT IN ('false') AND to_char(sys12_day, 'yyyy.mm') LIKE #{stdMonth} AND sys12_company_id = 1 ORDER BY sys12_day
